title: nan
authors: Zhou X.; Zhang X.; Yang X.; Zhao J.; Liu Z.; Shuang F.
key_contribution: Presents the SatLoc dataset and SatLoc-Fusion, a hierarchical adaptive fusion framework for micro-UAV localization in GNSS-denied environments, achieving real-time on-edge operation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Hybrid_Classical_Learning to ensure precise positioning.
